name: Pan Asian Microvent Tech (Jiangsu) Corporation
summary: Pan Asian Microvent Tech (Jiangsu) Corporation engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of e-PTFE micro-permeable membranes and aerogels in China and internationally. The company offers pre-filled injection pen; CMD condensation controller, fuel cell proton exchange membrane, water electrolysis for hydrogen production, flow battery ion exchange membrane, aerogel products, and anion exchange membrane; and green energy, new energy vehicle thermal management products, and new energy vehicle battery breathable products.
